2026-02-04 by Sam Utzinger


A total of 12,325 courses were scraped and 6151 were not duplicated over semesters. 41 contained "AI" related terms and I deemed only 19 of those actually teach about ai.


```{r chunk_1, echo=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)   # readr, dplyr, ggplot2, stringr, tibble
library(knitr)       # kable tables (optional)
```

```{r plot_theme, echo=FALSE}

theme_report <- function(base_size = 10) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      plot.title.position = "plot",
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey30"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 6)),
      axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 6)),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
}
```


```{r chunk_2, echo=FALSE, fig.height=3, fig.width=4.5}
input <- "C:/Users/samut/Desktop/DataSciClub/Scraping/data/handmade_nau_courses_ai.csv"
top <- 20

df <- readr::read_csv(input, show_col_types = FALSE)

counts <- df %>%
  count(subject, name = "Count") %>%
  arrange(Count)

if (!is.null(top) && top > 0) {
  counts <- counts %>% slice_tail(n = top)
}

created_table <- tibble(
  Subject = c("CS", "EE", "INF", "PSY", "ART", "CIT", "ETC", "PRM"),
  Count   = c(9, 2, 2, 2, 1, 1, 1, 1)
)
kable(created_table)

ggplot(counts, aes(x = reorder(subject, Count), y = Count)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.75) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Count), hjust = -0.15, size = 3) +
  coord_flip(clip = "off") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Top ", nrow(counts), " Departments with AI-Related Courses"),
    subtitle = "Counts from the curated AI course list",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Number of courses"
  ) +
  theme_report() +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(5.5, 20, 5.5, 5.5))  # adds right margin for labels

```

## Course Levels


```{r course_levels, echo=FALSE, fig.height=3, fig.width=4.5}
input_csv  <- "C:/Users/samut/Desktop/DataSciClub/Scraping/data/handmade_nau_courses_ai.csv"
output_png <- "level_split.png"

df <- readr::read_csv(input_csv, show_col_types = FALSE)

df2 <- df %>%
  mutate(
    course_num = as.integer(stringr::str_extract(course_display, "\\d{3}")),
    level = case_when(
      !is.na(course_num) & between(course_num, 100, 299) ~ "Intro (100-200)",
      !is.na(course_num) & between(course_num, 300, 499) ~ "Advanced (300-400)",
      !is.na(course_num) & course_num >= 500            ~ "Graduate (500+)",
      TRUE                                              ~ "Unknown"
    )
  )

counts_level <- df2 %>%
  count(level, name = "Count") %>%
  mutate(level = factor(level, levels = c(
    "Intro (100-200)", "Advanced (300-400)", "Graduate (500+)", "Unknown"
  ))) %>%
  arrange(level)

counts_level2 <- counts_level %>%
  filter(level != "Unknown") %>%
  mutate(
    pct = Count / sum(Count),
    label = paste0(Count, " (", scales::percent(pct, accuracy = 1), ")")
  )


```





```{r chunk_4, echo=FALSE, fig.height=3, fig.width=4.5}
df_table2 <- tibble(
  Subject = c(
    "Technical AI/ML (methods)",
    "Applied AI/ML (domain/project)",
    "AI literacy / ethics / impact",
    "AI-adjacent (robotics/generative art)",
    "Generative AI / learning analytics"
  ),
  Count = c(9, 5, 3, 1, 1)
)

kable(df_table2)
ggplot(counts_level2, aes(x = reorder(level, Count), y = Count)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), hjust = -0.15, size = 3) +
  coord_flip(clip = "off") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
  labs(
    title = "AI Course Levels",
    subtitle = "Intro vs Advanced vs Graduate",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Number of courses"
  ) +
  theme_report() +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(5.5, 22, 5.5, 5.5))
```

## Course Topics

```{r chunk_5, echo=FALSE, fig.height=3, fig.width=4.5}

df_table2_plot <- df_table2 %>%
  mutate(Subject_wrapped = stringr::str_wrap(Subject, width = 28))

ggplot(df_table2_plot, aes(x = reorder(Subject_wrapped, Count), y = Count)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.75) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Count), hjust = -0.15, size = 3) +
  coord_flip(clip = "off") +

  labs(
```
